segments.en: One should pray with deliberateness, with strength, with kavvanah, with joy, and with a pleasant voice. One should be precise in pronouncing the cholam vowel when saying the holy Name of Hashem Yisborach — and one should also stress the yud in "Adonai." All the holy Names should be said with awe. For through this prayer all harsh judgments are sweetened, and one merits to strengthen oneself — to stand against all the descents and darknesses and obstacles that pass over every person — in the aspect of "He who guards His people Israel forever."
